opening.argument: The presentation directs viewers to fund Ethereum wallets, enter an inviter link and ID, and join Forsage through paid activation and upgrades. The speaker ties an Ethereum payment to activating a level, then presents earnings alongside the need to upgrade. Two partners and active X3 and X4 levels place those payments within a tiered recruitment matrix. The registration walkthrough culminates in an instruction to obtain the sharer's link and register. These details establish a scam promotion that actively guides participation and presents earnings and partners as part of the opportunity.
